text:
Talia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Leadership asked us to post a single-thread summary with firm windows, owners, and any "MUST" blockers vs things we can push. Paste 1-line status + MUST/CAN_DEFER.
Owen: API: targeting early-Q3 (approx 4-6w). Owner: Owen + Platform. MUST: SLA legal signoff, pricing table final. CAN_DEFER: noncritical admin endpoints and minor telemetry fields. Beta features (structured output/tool-calls) are in limited beta and not GA blockers.
Priyanka: Gateway bug: reproducer under mixed streaming + short calls. Patch submitted, CI running. If CI green I can promote to staging today and run 48h soak. Contingency is revert and hotfix (2d). Status: in-review -> CI. MUST/CAN_DEFER: CAN_DEFER (mitigatable by canary gating), but SLA depends on making this robust.
Samir: Runtime/Dedicated: need to validate p99 tail for GA cohort. Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 72h observation windows. We'll gate progress on p99 and OOM/noise signals. Owner: Samir (Eng-runtime). MUST: p99 stability on Dedicated.
Ivy: Console: mid-Q3 for core admin + rollout flows (dashboards, per-route model config, rollout UI). Owner: Ivy (Console PM). MUST: rollout UI + model pinning. CAN_DEFER: Optimize UX, quantization UI, and external APM link. Proposal: scope down widgets to hit mid-Q3.
Owen: Finance ask: pricing guidance needed 10 business days before GA to lock billing surface. Owner: Finance (cc @Marcus). MUST.
legal-bot: SLA redline review scheduled Fri 15:00 PT. Ping @Legal if you need faster review.
Priyanka: Patch promoted to staging at 11:20. Running tests and 48h soak. Will post metrics link when available.
Samir: Ops note: canary thresholds we'll use: error_rate > 0.5% OR p99 increase > 30% triggers automatic rollback. Implementing auto-rollback with 5m cooloff. I'll post the exact alert query in the checklist doc.
Talia: Optimize timeline: public beta late-Q3, GA in Q4. Owner: Owen + Research. MUST: 3 production evals showing net unit-cost wins. CAN_DEFER: advanced UI for quantization knobs. Blocker: infra quota for per-tenant batched experiments.
Owen: Leadership ask: can teams accept deferring the APM integration to Q4 if that helps Console mid-Q3? Please reply MUST/CAN_DEFER.
Ivy: CAN_DEFER. Deferring frees ~2 sprints and shouldn't impact customer rollouts.
Priyanka: If staging soak passes, I'll open the canary rollout ticket for tomorrow.
Talia: Action items (tracked): 1) Owen/Finance: confirm pricing cadence within 10bd. 2) Priyanka: land gateway patch and post 48h soak results. 3) Samir: run Dedicated p99 canary after patch; publish thresholds/rollback rules. 4) Ivy: publish Console GA scope doc and mark deferrables. 5) Owen/Research: open infra quota ticket for per-tenant batch evals.
ops-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync Thu 09:00 PT.
Talia: I'll maintain the single checklist doc and tag owners. Link (internal): https://redwood-internal.company/roadmaps/ga-checklist. Please update this thread if dates slip. :thumbsup:
